senses.gloss: जिन (I) a. (f. ना) 1. Victorious, triumphant; 2. very old.
जिन (II) m. 1. A generic term for a chief Bauddha or Jaina saint; 2. a term applied to the Arhats of the Jainas; 3. an epithet of Viṣṇu.
जिन (I) a. (f. ना) 1. Victorious, triumphant; 2. very old.
जीन (I) a. (f. ना) Old, aged, decayed.
जीन (II) n. A leather bag, जीनकार्मुकबस्तावीन् पृथग् दद्याद्विशुद्धये M.xi.138. (In Mandlik’s edition of Manu, however, the reading of the text is जिन, though the commentators read जीन.)
जीन (I) a. (f. ना) Old, aged, decayed.
जिन-इंद्र, -ईश्वर m. 1. a chief Bauddha saint; 2. an Arhat of the Jainas.
जिन-इंद्र, -ईश्वर m. 1. a chief Bauddha saint; 2. an Arhat of the Jainas.
जिन-सद्मन् n. a Jaina temple or monastery.
